name: AL Language XApp B
brief: Cross-app fixture B: extends the objects of cross-app fixture A.
description: Table extensions of cross-app fixture A's tables, a page with a protected variable whose type comes from the AL Internals Test Fixture app, and subscribers of the cross-app order probe. Depends on cross-app fixture A and the AL Internals Test Fixture. The app id, name and publisher are fixed on purpose: they decide the candidate orders of the cross-app subscriber order probe (CONTRIBUTING.md, "Multi-app fixtures"). Do not change them.
